hero_kpi_rationale: PODD's growth model relies on recurring sales of disposable Pods replaced every 3 days by users, creating a recurring and predictable revenue stream similar to a subscription, and representing the primary driver of its growth trajectory.

kpis.name: Recurring Pod Sales
kpis.explanation: Sales of disposable Pods replaced every 3 days by users, generating recurring revenue.
kpis.description: Omnipod Pod sales represent the majority of revenue and are tied to an expanding customer base. The 'pay-as-you-go' model reinforces revenue recurrence.
kpis.signal: Strong recurring business model with >30% growth in constant currency

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold (COGS).
kpis.description: Gross margin has improved due to manufacturing efficiency gains, higher average selling prices, and the absence of Omnipod GO-related costs in 2025.
kpis.signal: High gross margin for a medical hardware model, improving

kpis.name: R&D Investment as % of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue invested in research and development of new products.
kpis.description: R&D is increasing in both absolute and percentage-of-revenue terms, driven by hiring and clinical trials for next-generation insulin systems.
kpis.signal: Increased investment in product innovation (Omnipod 6, Libre 3 integration)

kpis.name: Estimated Active Users
kpis.explanation: Number of global users actively using the Omnipod system.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, over 600,000 estimated active users support recurring Pod demand.
kpis.signal: Large and growing installed base, key to recurring model

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit relative to total revenue.
kpis.description: Calculated from operating income: (2708.1 - 768.2 - 301.1 - 1165.0) / 2708.1 = 17.5%. Slight decline due to headcount increases and marketing investments.
kpis.signal: Operating margin under pressure due to commercial investments

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €3.19 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.95 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €0.72 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 6 fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $2.708 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of $0.247 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Type 2 Diabetes Market Expansion
kpis.explanation: Growth strategy focused on launching Omnipod 5 for type 2 diabetic patients.
kpis.description: In 2024, PODD decided to focus efforts on Omnipod 5 for type 2 following a successful trial, discontinuing Omnipod GO. This significantly expands the TAM.
kpis.signal: Strategic pivot to a larger market (type 2)

kpis.name: FDA Clearance for Type 2 Indication
kpis.explanation: Key regulatory approval enabling use of Omnipod 5 in type 2 diabetic patients.
kpis.description: In August 2024, PODD obtained FDA clearance to extend Omnipod 5's indication to type 2 diabetes, a critical milestone for future growth.
kpis.signal: Regulatory access to a massive market

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Exposure to interest rate fluctuations, mitigated by swap agreements covering $460M of Term Loan B

risks.title: Currency Risk
risks.score_rationale: Significant exposure to foreign exchange rate fluctuations for 28% of revenues in foreign currencies

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk of customer non-payment, mitigated by allowance for doubtful accounts

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: High exposure to FDA/CMS/OIG regulatory changes and FCPA, UK Bribery Act compliance

risks.title: Operational Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk of operational disruption due to supply chain complexity, medical manufacturing, and tariff exposure
